title: ieee80211: Add Aruba GPS Ellipse
description:
This adds support for dissecting HPE Aruba Networking GPS Ellipse data from beacons/probe responses. This vendor IE contains location information including latitude, longitude, ellipse dimensions, orientation, and distance values.

![image](/uploads/bb090144606b00a8efaff5a52fb07cbc/image.png)
